title: Associations
intro: Each association has its own people list, its meetings and its invite link.
emptyTitle: You're not in any association yet
emptyText: Has someone sent you an invite link? Open it and you'll end up in the right place. Otherwise, create the association below — you become its admin and can invite the rest.
name: Name
